messages:
Samira Patel: Received SIG/CAIQ + customer custom questionnaire from AcmeFin. Attached PDF in the intake form. They want answers by EOD Friday if possible — POC timeline is tight. CC @Derek (Sales Ops).
Jordan Lee: Got it. I'll upload to the intake tracker and route to Sec. Any red flags we should prioritize (KMS/BYOK, data residency, SSO)?
Alex Morgan: Main asks: customer-managed keys (BYOK) for model weights, HSM support, SSO/SCIM, encryption-at-rest details, and a short pen-test summary.
Priya Singh: sec-bot created INC-2026-4587 and assigned to me. Deadline noted.
sec-bot: New intake INC-2026-4587 created. Priority: High. SLA target: 72h.
Priya Singh: I'll own drafting the SIG answers. Need to confirm deployment target (Dedicated vs Private) since BYOK options differ.
Samira Patel: Sales says they're evaluating Dedicated first but may move to Private for regulated data. Will confirm.
Jordan Lee: Can someone drop the CAIQ link and the custom Q snippet here so I can triage sections?
Alex Morgan: Uploaded CAIQ and custom Qs to the intake doc: https://redwood.internal/dropbox/acmefin-sig.pdf
Alex Morgan: Custom Q excerpt: "Q12: Can customers provide KMS keys for model weights encryption? Describe key rotation and HSM controls."
Priya Singh: We support BYOK in Private (full KMS/HSM) and tenant CMK referencing for Dedicated in select regions. Need region info to be precise. Also will request SOC2 evidence + pen-test.
Samira Patel: Customer requested SOC2 Type II and a pen-test summary. Sales note: SOC2 Type II preferred but ISO acceptable as fallback.
Priya Singh: Action items: 1) Alex — confirm region availability + post CAIQ (done). 2) Jordan/Derek — confirm Dedicated region and whether customer will sign DPA. 3) Samira — confirm customer preference Dedicated vs Private. I'll draft answers for BYOK, rotation policy, and limitations. ETA 48h for draft.
Alex Morgan: Region availability: us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Dedicated CMK referencing supported in those regions. On-prem BYOK requires infra-eng engagement. Note: we currently do NOT support direct key import for model weight encryption — only referencing external KMS keys. I'll document this limitation.
Jordan Lee: Sales Ops confirms initial POC region = us-west-2. Derek to share legal contact for DPA.
Derek (Sales Ops): Sharing contact offline. Will push DPA template to legal and loop back here.
Priya Singh: Perfect. If anyone has redacted SOC2/pen-test artifacts, attach here so I can reference controls and map CAIQ responses.
Samira Patel: Uploading redacted SOC2 and pen-test summary now. Will message the customer asking whether Dedicated or Private is preferred for POC.
sec-bot: Attached: redacted_SOC2_2025.pdf, pen-test-summary-2025.txt
Alex Morgan: Quick technical clarifier for the draft: BYOK usage is supported via external KMS references for inference pipelines; key import for weights not supported. Also document rotation windows and audit logging path (Cloud KMS -> KMS audit logs -> Console).
Priya Singh: Noted — I'll include that as a limitation and map to control IDs in the CAIQ.
Samira Patel: I'll confirm with the customer and get back within a few hours.
Jordan Lee: Updating INC-2026-4587 -> In Progress. Expect initial draft answers in ~48 hours.
Priya Singh: I'll post the draft answers here before they go to the customer. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
